activities.name: ForEach table in RMA
activities.description: One Copy per catalog row, 20 in parallel. A table that copied is added to LoadedTables (only those go to the lakehouse); a table that failed is added to FailedTables with its error, and the others carry on.

activities.name: Extract to RAW parquet
activities.description: Runs the ExtractQuery of the catalog row (full table, or changes since the watermark minus 1 day) and writes parquet once, straight to Files/raw (DPV1: Copy into RAW/DATASOURCE=…).

activities.name: Add to loaded tables
activities.description: The catalog row of a table that copied: the notebook loads it with its keys and load method.

activities.name: Add to failed tables
activities.description: The table and the Copy error: listed in the failure message of the master.

activities.name: Return loaded and failed tables
activities.description: Gives the master the tables that went through this step and the ones that failed, with their error.
